title: Frontend: Reset password page
description: Build the reset password page. Reads the token from the URL query parameter and submits it with the new password.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows error if no token present
Form with newPassword and confirmNewPassword fields
Validates passwords match and meet minimum length
On success: shows success message with link to login
On error (invalid/expired token): shows error message

steps.details: src/pages/ResetPasswordPage.tsx. useSearchParams to get token. Form: newPassword + confirmPassword with validation (min 8, must match). POST /api/auth/reset-password with { token, newPassword }. On success: show 'Password updated! Sign in.' On error: show error.
Navigate to /reset-password with valid token — submit new password — verify success. Try with expired/invalid token — verify error. Try without token in URL — verify error shown immediately.
